Container.Name: Fresharr
Container.Overview: Fresharr discovers new and highly rated movies, TV shows and anime from Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd, TMDB, Trakt, AniList and MyAnimeList, and adds them to Radarr and Sonarr automatically (anime series get Sonarr's anime type, and can go to their own root folder). All configuration happens in the web interface: connections and API keys, per-site toggles and score thresholds, original-language filters for movies/TV/anime, limits and the run schedule. Runs happen on a background thread at a random time around your chosen interval, never less than 18 hours apart - the web UI does not need to be open. Start with DRY_RUN=true to preview what it would add before letting it loose.
Container.Requires: A Radarr and/or Sonarr install to add titles to. Only one of the two is required. TMDB and Trakt are optional but recommended - both need a free API key entered in the web interface.
Container.Changes:
### 0.1.1 - Security: stored API keys are no longer returned by the web API. - Anime can be routed to its own root folder; optional tag on everything added. - Separate movie/TV score thresholds; back-catalog mode for older titles. - Much faster runs on large libraries; a stalled Radarr/Sonarr no longer stalls the run.
### 0.1.0 - First beta. Discovery from seven sites, full web-interface configuration, randomized scheduling, and original-language filters for movies, TV and anime.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Fresharr web interface, where all settings live.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Stores Fresharr's settings (connections, thresholds, schedule, enabled sites) and its state file (which titles were already added).

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true = only log what would be added, don't touch Radarr/Sonarr. Set to false once you're happy with the results.
